dedupe_keys.name: eries a benchmark study on pedestrian level winds

description: ERIES publishes wind-tunnel measurements for pedestrian-level wind comfort around a tall building in a dense urban layout inspired by Manchester Deansgate. Configurations vary wind direction, target-building massing, mitigation elements and probe layout. Velocity-ratio time series and supporting metadata are described as an engineering benchmark. Coverage: Temporal coverage is not stated in the reviewed source. Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: CSV, XLSX, PDF, STEP, DWG, JPEG and PNG images and plain text. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: The earlier single-study rejection is superseded by source-defined urban-building benchmark evidence. Scaling and full-size wind comfort were not independently tested. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
